<h2 class="heading heading__theme-color-3 wp-block-vacareers-heading"><strong>Creating future VA healthcare professionals</strong></h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">VA offers several scholarship programs for aspiring healthcare professionals in exchange for their service in a critical occupation at a VA medical facility. If our mission of improving the lives of Veterans calls to you, we want you to apply. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is the official VA Website for the Health Professional Scholarship Program (HPSP), Visual Impairment and Orientation and Mobility Professionals Scholarship Program (VIOMPSP), and the HPSP Vet Center (Readjustment Counseling Service) Scholarship. Previous websites under the Intelliworx URL are no longer valid. Websites outside of this page may not have accurate or up to date information and should not be viewed as the official source.</p>



<hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity" />


<div class="grid-row grid-gap wp-block-vacareers-columns-row">
    
<div class="tablet-lg:grid-col wp-block-vacareers-column">
    
<h3 class="heading wp-block-vacareers-heading">Benefits at a glance</h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Full tuition</strong> at a U.S. regionally accredited school.</li>



<li><strong>Monthly stipend</strong> to help with living expenses.</li>



<li><strong>Annual book stipend</strong> for instructional materials.</li>



<li><strong>Career at VA</strong> after you graduate and meet VA qualification standards.</li>
</ul>

</div>

<div class="tablet-lg:grid-col wp-block-vacareers-column">
    
<h3 class="heading wp-block-vacareers-heading">Eligibility at a glance</h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Full-time enrollment </strong>in a qualifying program at a U.S. regionally accredited college or university.</li>



<li><strong>3.5 cumulative GPA</strong> with official transcript. Transcripts must show 15 earned credit hours within the past 5 years at the time of applying.<em> NOTE: Non-credit courses or courses taken to earn professional certifications/board certifications or skills certificate are not considered eligible as part of the 15 most recent earned credits within a 5-year period.</em></li>



<li>Must be a <strong>US. Citizen</strong>, and 18 years of age or older, and must be able to pass background check to gain security clearance. </li>



<li><strong>Not in default or delinquent on federal debt.</strong></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="heading heading__theme-color-3 wp-block-vacareers-heading">Health Professional Scholarship Program (HPSP)</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">HPSP awards scholarships to students receiving education/training in a healthcare services discipline. In exchange, you agree to serve in a VA health care facility for a minimum 2-year service obligation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is a highly competitive scholarship and only the most competitive applicants will be selected from their collective field of study. The minimum eligibility requirements are not negotiable or able to be waived. <em>Service obligation times may vary and based on specific healthcare occupations.</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">HPSP stands ready to help VA fill rural, critical, and hard to fill vacancies across the U.S. 100% of HPSP scholars will relocate at their own expense to accept an assignment serving Veterans in one of those vacancies. Even if there is a VA local to you, you will relocate to your assignment if you accept an HPSP scholarship.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">2027 Scholarships are offered for the following clinical roles:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Physicians (MD/DO)</li>



<li>Registered Nurse (ADN/BSN)</li>



<li>Nurse Practitioner (mental health only)</li>



<li>Psychology</li>



<li>Social Work (Master’s)</li>
</ul>

            <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="4cacc71a-d23c-4e12-8911-b3e982e366ba">

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Enrollment</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Unconditionally accepted in the accredited academic program that will qualify for employment in one of the professional fields associated with the scholarship program. Proof of enrollment and unconditional acceptance must be provided at time of application.</li>



<li>Academic institution must be located within the U.S., accredited, and at the educational level required.</li>



<li>Dual enrollment, dual majors, pre-requisite courses, or multiple applications are not considered.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Cumulative grade point average (CGPA)</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Have a 3.5 cumulative GPA (CGPA) with official transcript. Transcripts must show 15 earned credit hours within the past 5 years at the time of applying.<em> NOTE: Non-credit courses or courses taken to earn professional certifications/board certifications or skills certificate are not considered eligible as part of the 15 most recent earned credits within a 5-year period.</em></li>



<li>Pass/Fail courses are accepted. An official letter from your academic institution must outline the converted CGPA to a 4.0 scale with total credit hours earned.  </li>



<li>Determination of qualifying CGPA:
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Most recent educational level
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The cumulative GPA from the applicant’s most recent (highest) educational level will be used to determine eligibility, provided the applicant has successfully completed at least <strong>15 credit hours</strong> at that educational level.</li>



<li>Educational levels include undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, and professional degree programs.</li>
</ul>
</li>



<li>Fewer than 15 completed credit hours
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>If an applicant has completed fewer than 15 credit hours at their most recent educational level, the cumulative GPA from the next lower educational level will be used to determine eligibility, provided that educational level meets the minimum credit-hour requirement.</li>



<li>Applicants may not substitute a higher GPA from a previous educational level if their most recent educational level meets the 15-credit-hour requirement.</li>



<li>GPAs from different educational levels will not be averaged or combined.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Medical student academic eligibility requirements</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Applicants pursuing a medical degree must meet both of the following minimum academic requirements to be eligible for consideration under the HPSP:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>CGPA: A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 on a 4.00 scale.</li>



<li>Medical College Admission Test (MCAT): A minimum total MCAT score of 510.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Applicants must satisfy <strong><em>both</em></strong> requirements. A higher CGPA cannot compensate for an MCAT score below 510, and an MCAT score above 510 cannot compensate for a cumulative GPA below 3.50.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Applicants enrolled in an educational program that utilizes a pass/fail grading system and does not issue a cumulative numerical GPA must provide an academic transcript from their <strong>previous educational level</strong>. The cumulative GPA from the previous qualifying educational level will be used regardless of the number of credit hours completed in the current pass/fail program.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If your school does not require an MCAT score, you will not be eligible for consideration.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Citizenship and age</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>18 years of age or older.</li>



<li>U.S. Citizen as defined by birth or naturalization. <em>Note: Work visas and resident alien status are not accepted</em>. </li>



<li>Pass background checks, security clearance, or other pre-onboarding requirements as determined by VA.  </li>



<li>Veteran status is not required for any of the eligible programs listed. </li>



<li>Cannot be completing an existing service obligation to another program, federal agency, or entity at time of application.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Federal debt</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Not in default or delinquent on any federal debt, defined as 31 days past due on a scheduled payment, taxes, audit disallowances, guaranteed or direct student loans, Federal Housing Administration (FHA) or VA mortgages, and other miscellaneous administrative debt. </li>
</ul>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Registered Nurses: </strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Nursing education must be from a school of professional nursing accredited by one of the following two accrediting organizations at the time the program was completed by the applicant: </p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN)</li>



<li><strong> </strong>The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE)</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Physicians:</strong> </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Hold a degree of Doctor of Medicine or an equivalent degree resulting from a course of education in allopathic medicine or osteopathic medicine. The degree must have been obtained from an institution whose accreditation was in place for the year in which the course of study was completed.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Approved schools are:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Schools of medicine accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) for the year in which the degree was granted. </li>



<li>Schools of osteopathic medicine approved by the Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation of the American Osteopathic Association for the year in which the degree was granted. </li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Psychologists: </strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Hold a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology at the time the program is completed, accredited by one of the following: </p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The American Psychological Association (APA) </li>



<li>The Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS)  </li>



<li>The Canadian Psychological Association (CPA)  </li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. To meet this requirement, the term “specialty area” refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science. CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas, except for school psychology. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">School Psychology degrees do not qualify. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Social Workers: </strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Hold a master’s degree in social work from a school of social work fully accredited by the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE). Graduates of schools of social work that are in candidacy status do not meet this requirement until the School of Social Work is fully accredited.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A doctoral degree in social work may not be substituted for the master’s degree in social work. Verification of the degree can be made by going to <a href="http://www.cswe.org/Accreditation" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">http://www.cswe.org/Accreditation</a> to verify that the social work degree meets the accreditation standards for a Master of Social Work. </p>

</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. To meet this requirement, the term “specialty area” refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science. CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas, except for school psychology. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">School Psychology degrees do not qualify. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Social Workers: </strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Have a master’s degree in social work from a school of social work fully accredited by the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE). Graduates of schools of social work that are in candidacy status do not meet this requirement until the School of Social Work is fully accredited.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A doctoral degree in social work may not be substituted for the master’s degree in social work. Verification of the degree can be made by going to <a href="http://www.cswe.org/Accreditation" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">http://www.cswe.org/Accreditation</a> to verify that the social work degree meets the accreditation standards for a Master of Social Work. </p>

        </div>
    </div>

<section class="section bg-white wp-block-vacareers-section-container" id="faqs">
	<div class="grid-container">
		
<h2 class="heading heading__theme-color-3 wp-block-vacareers-heading">Frequently asked questions</h2>



<div class="usa-accordion accordion-group usa-accordion--multiselectable wp-block-vacareers-accordion-group" data-allow-multiple="">
    
    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="fdefb36e-3ec1-4d48-9d77-0a2b2858198c">
            Do I have to be a Veteran to apply?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="fdefb36e-3ec1-4d48-9d77-0a2b2858198c" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No, Veteran status is not required. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="26fee06c-d5ea-418b-a226-00bff0ef4cbb">
            Are there additional program requirements?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="26fee06c-d5ea-418b-a226-00bff0ef4cbb" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Recipients must be willing to relocate (at their own expense) after earning their degree and must meet all VA qualification standards for the healthcare occupation for which the scholarship was awarded. Every scholarship participant will sign a mobility agreement in conjunction with their agreement that affirms they are willing to move, at their own expense, anywhere in the U.S. to meet Veteran care needs where they are most critical.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="9f57562d-e1eb-4c24-a8ba-69be25134f03">
            Are HPSP participants eligible for recruitment or relocation incentives?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="9f57562d-e1eb-4c24-a8ba-69be25134f03" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">HPSP scholarship recipients are not eligible to receive any recruitment or relocation incentives offered while completing their obligated service. Accepting any recruitment or relocation incentives will result in incurring a debt that the HPSP scholarship recipient will be obligated to repay in full.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Stipend Overpayments-All HPSP/Vet Center participants <strong>must</strong> submit a Leave of Absence (LOA) request in AMS. Undergoing an LOA would include, but is not limited to, recipients beginning their residency or internship or leaving the course of study prior to the recipient’s scholarship completion award date. Failure to not submit an LOA will result in erroneous stipends or federal government debt. Current HPSP/Vet Center participants who have been notified of their stipend overpayments are eligible to submit a stipend waiver. For more information, please contact the HPSP office (<a href="mailto:VHAHPSPTeam@VA.gov" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">VHAHPSPTeam@VA.gov</a>).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Fees not covered (as of 1 Jan 2027):</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Room/Board/Meal Tickets/Café Services/Commons Access/Mess Charge Fees</li>



<li>Books/Uniforms/Non-Class Specific Equipment/Online Support Fees</li>



<li>Application/Drug Screening/Background Investigation/Records/Audit Fees</li>



<li>Health/Life/Dental/Vision Insurance Fees/Disability Insurance/Health Fee/Medical Liability Insurance</li>



<li>Transportation/Parking /Bus/Travel/Study Abroad Fees</li>



<li>Student Government/Student Body/Union/Organization Membership/Class Fees</li>



<li>Student Records/Counseling/Health & Wellness/Activity/Facility/Rec Center/Endowment/Student Self-Help</li>



<li>Late Charge/Repeat Coursework/Penalty Fees</li>



<li>Certification Board/Licensure & Certification/Testing/Dissertation Fees</li>



<li>Others as determined at the discretion of the VA Secretary or appointed staff</li>
</ul>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="4a9f9c12-559d-4401-864d-c1d9fef837f3">
            Can I apply if I am under a current service obligation in VA or another organization?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="4a9f9c12-559d-4401-864d-c1d9fef837f3" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Generally, no. An applicant who already owes a post-training service obligation to VA or another entity is ineligible for HPSP while that conflicting obligation exists. Reserve Components of the military are exempt from this and are welcome to apply.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="13aa273b-ee96-489d-9f9f-e33a8d1564e7">
            Can a permanent resident or green-card holder apply?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="13aa273b-ee96-489d-9f9f-e33a8d1564e7" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">HPSP eligibility requires U.S. citizenship by birth or naturalization. Resident-alien status or a work visa do not satisfy that requirement.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="88794e8a-132e-486e-8c02-436f1fffa8e0">
            Can I apply if I am delinquent on a federal debt?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="88794e8a-132e-486e-8c02-436f1fffa8e0" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Applicants cannot be in <strong>default or delinquent</strong> on any federal debt. Delinquency is described as 31 days past a scheduled payment and included federal student loans, taxes, mortgages, and other administrative debt.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="950a0b97-c496-4afd-a4e8-285580bb5fd1">
            Is there a clinical requirement?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="950a0b97-c496-4afd-a4e8-285580bb5fd1" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">To meet the needs of the clinical requirement, simply work with your program’s clinical coordinator who can help you identify your program’s existing affiliations. Make every effort to attend a clinical rotation at VA, if an existing affiliation exists and positions are available. If no clinical positions are available at VA — whether due to limited slots or no existing affiliation — the requirement will be waived. Your institution determines the clinical assignment; HPSP has no influence or control over that decision.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="6a93f6d8-2871-424c-a053-edcb2a887a1d">
            Are there educational program requirements?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="6a93f6d8-2871-424c-a053-edcb2a887a1d" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. You must be enrolled full-time in a program of study for which the scholarship was awarded at a regionally accredited U.S. college or university.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="d276f36b-5691-4704-94e9-8a66f623fa32">
            What happens if my academic program or graduation date changes?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="d276f36b-5691-4704-94e9-8a66f623fa32" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Material changes can affect scholarship eligibility, funding, and the service timeline and should be reported to the HPSP program office. A participant who voluntarily terminates the funded course of study or, in applicable circumstances, changes from full-time to part-time status can trigger breach or repayment provisions.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="3f5aa8c0-f5ba-4cb7-911b-67de3bcbb2b5">
            What if I fail to maintain acceptable academic standing?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="3f5aa8c0-f5ba-4cb7-911b-67de3bcbb2b5" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Failure to maintain acceptable academic standing can terminate participation and create a repayment obligation under the HPSP agreement and governing regulations.</p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="bffa3358-d36f-4e5b-b3c6-622800575d70">
            How long do I have to obtain professional licensure?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="bffa3358-d36f-4e5b-b3c6-622800575d70" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Where licensure is required, the regulation sets timelines within which an individual must become licensed in a U.S. state or territory after becoming eligible to apply. Failure to do so can result in breach consequences. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="dad2c175-7eec-407a-a0e3-17234a0de6cf">
            Can I submit multiple applications?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="dad2c175-7eec-407a-a0e3-17234a0de6cf" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No. Only 1 application per user is reviewed. Duplicate accounts or applications aren’t accepted. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="7fff2f24-e863-4076-ac9c-616c2b03a7ef">
            When will my scholarship start?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="7fff2f24-e863-4076-ac9c-616c2b03a7ef" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The scholarship starts the first day of the next semester following the signing of the HPSP agreement/contract by the recipient and the VA Under Secretary of Health (USH) or designee. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="2973b191-5784-452b-a8b3-5ffb0a824f96">
            Do I have to claim my stipends on my taxes?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="2973b191-5784-452b-a8b3-5ffb0a824f96" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No, stipends are tax-free. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="b1c800e9-3f92-4eb5-b643-c4ecd2c37c87">
            What is the deadline to apply for the HPSP scholarship?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="b1c800e9-3f92-4eb5-b643-c4ecd2c37c87" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Deadlines are posted on this page. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e35c17b6-bca3-43d2-9eff-92e7f0f329e1">
            Can my VA service obligation be deferred for residency or other advanced clinical training?         </button>
    </div>
    <div id="e35c17b6-bca3-43d2-9eff-92e7f0f329e1" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For specified professions—including medicine, osteopathy, dentistry, optometry and podiatry—a participant may request deferment to complete approved advanced clinical training. Deferment is not automatic and is governed by VA approval and program requirements. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c883ea18-876d-40eb-af05-8167aafb493b">
            Can advanced clinical training add more obligated service?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="c883ea18-876d-40eb-af05-8167aafb493b" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. When VA approves certain deferred advanced clinical training, additional service can be imposed. The regulatory formula varies depending on whether the specialty is determined necessary to meet VHA healthcare requirements.  </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="020c2cff-a85c-43be-9a56-dc197f5317a8">
            Does internship or residency itself count as repayment of the HPSP service obligation?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="020c2cff-a85c-43be-9a56-dc197f5317a8" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Generally, the obligated service period begins with a qualifying VA appointment and service after completion of the education requirement or approved deferred training. Training time should not be assumed to count toward the service obligation unless the participant’s governing agreement and applicable authority specifically provide for it. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="effda854-b83e-44c5-afb0-554319ac697f">
            Do I get to choose which VA facility I work at?         </button>
    </div>
    <div id="effda854-b83e-44c5-afb0-554319ac697f" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Participants should not assume a guaranteed facility of choice. HPSP is a workforce program, and placement is tied to VA staffing needs and qualifying vacancies. Participants sign a mobility agreement affirming understanding of the relocation requirement. Preferences may be considered, but the governing agreement and VA placement process control. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="09c8a1c6-deb7-47e4-824b-c8120081bc2d">
            How long is the HPSP service obligation?        </button>
    </div>
    <div id="09c8a1c6-deb7-47e4-824b-c8120081bc2d" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">There is a minimum 2-year service obligation for HPSP participants. While particular occupations, scholarship durations, and special HPSP tracks can carry different obligations, the controlling sources are the statute, regulations, and the signed scholarship agreement applicable to the participant. These range from 2 years for RNs, and up to 6 years for Specialty Providers and Vet Center Scholarship recipients. </p>

    </div>
    

    <div class="usa-accordion__heading">
        <button type="button" class="usa-accordion__button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="69034fec-5d71-4ce7-9832-7f604696d04e">
            When does obligated service begin?         </button>
    </div>
    <div id="69034fec-5d71-4ce7-9832-7f604696d04e" class="usa-accordion__content usa-prose" hidden>
        

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For participants whose service has been deferred for approved advanced training, the regulation describes service beginning with appointment in full-time clinical practice at the VA assignment or location determined by the Secretary. Other occupations follow their applicable HPSP agreement and placement rules after educational and qualification requirements are completed. For all others, while working in their VA assignment, the obligated service begins once the participant has obtained their independent level of licensure.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Vet Center participants: Vet Center HPSP participants begin their Service Obligation on their initial placement date. </p>

    </div>
    
</div>
	</div>
</section>
